description: Unit tests for the ObservationBuffer class in the net::nqe::internal namespace, verifying buffer size limits, percentile calculations, observation removal, and RTT calculations.

classes.name: ObservationBuffer
classes.description: A buffer for network quality observations supporting percentile calculations and observation management.

methods.name: AddObservation
methods.description: Adds a network quality observation to the buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current number of observations in the buffer.

methods.name: GetPercentile
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves a specified percentile of observations, considering timestamps and RSSI.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all observations from the buffer.
